headline: BlackRock and Kotak Lead 1,905-Crore Rupee Block Stake in Groww
summary: Kotak Mutual Fund and BlackRock led a 1,905-crore rupee institutional block investment in Indian investment platform Groww, boosting the company's shares by nearly 2% during broader market declines.
why: Groww is one of India's largest retail discount stockbroking and mutual fund distribution platforms, serving millions of individual retail investors.

impacts.name: Groww
impacts.why: Major institutional buying led by BlackRock and Kotak drove a 2% share gain.
